regime_context: The detector shows a narrow, one-narrative leadership structure in China A-shares: only Coal (rank 1, eligible) and Banks (rank 2, eligible) clear the absolute-trend gate, with Coal leading by a thin margin over a crowded Banks theme. The validated drawdown-avoidance edge did NOT hold on this market's history (gate_helps=false, backtest says mean-reverting tape whipsaws the gate), and the past 95 graded calls show directional accuracy of just 34.7% — so any lean here is low-conviction by construction.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the Banks theme (durability 0.82, breadth 0.94, trend-tagged) completes a CONFIRMED handoff from Coal by holding its eligible status while Coal's durability_bar falls below its current 0.50 and Coal drops out of eligible — the condition that would retire this watch is Coal reclaiming a clear score lead over Banks for five consecutive sessions.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks is the only other eligible theme besides Coal and shows the strongest trend-health texture in the board: durability_bar 0.82, breadth 0.944, and a 'trend' hurst tag, versus Coal's 0.50 durability / 0.50 breadth / 'mean-revert' tag. This favors Banks as the more internally coherent trend candidate even though it is crowded (crowding_z 1.83). The crowding flag is a size-down caution only, not a fade.
evidence: eligible: true with durability_bar 0.82 (highest in board)
crowding_z 1.83 / crowded: true — treated as sizing caution, not a sell
theses.dissent: Banks is the most crowded theme on the board (z 1.83), and the detector's own backtest says the trend gate does not reduce drawdown on this mean-reverting tape — so a crowded trend tag may simply mark a late-stage extension rather than durable leadership.
